question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A group of guns or missile launchers operated together at one place
solution:
The correct answer is-'Battery'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's check the marked option:

 
 
• ***Battery: two or more big military guns that are controlled as a unit***

 
 
• ***​***"anti-aircraft missile **batteries**"*** ***
 
 
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words 'A group of guns or missile launchers operated together at one place' is 'Battery'.
 
• Thus, *option 4) *is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
